# Libertas Institute

> > Libertas Institute advances liberty through state-level policy advocacy, focusing on constitutional rights, anti-commandeering principles, and government reform.

A policy organization working on state sovereignty issues, federal-state relations, and constitutional advocacy. The institute collaborates with partner organizations across multiple states and provides tools for legislative engagement including email campaigns and bill tracking.

## Key Topics

- 10th Amendment
- Anti-Commandeering Doctrine
- Utah Constitutional Sovereignty Act
- State Sovereignty
- Constitutional Rights
- Federal-State Relations
- SB 57
- Legislative Advocacy
- Government Reform
- Policy Collaboration
- Freedom & Liberty
- State-Level Policy
- Utah Politics

## Legislative Advocacy & Campaigns

- [SB 57 Email Campaign - House Committee](https://libertas.institute/email_legislator.php?target=committee&committee=HSTNAE&sponsor_id=SANDASD&bill_type=SB&bill=57&year=2024): Email campaign tool for SB 57 Utah Constitutional Sovereignty Act

## Network & Partnerships

- [Partners](https://libertas.institute/partners/): State-by-state partner organizations and policy collaboration network
